records.objectives_text: Return to Sky Commander Adaris with the news about Terokk's return.

records.name: A Shabby Disguise

records.name: Terokk's Downfall
records.objectives_text: Take the :Time-Lost Offering prepared by Hazzik to the Skull Pile at the center of Skettis and summon and defeat Terokk. Return to Sky Commander Adaris when you've completed this task.

records.name: The Netherwing Mines
records.objectives_text: Seek out the Mistress of the Mines on Netherwing Ledge.

records.name: Picking Up The Pieces...
records.objectives_text: The Mistress of the Mines at the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to recover 15 Nethermine Cargo crates.

records.name: Dragons are the Least of Our Problems
records.objectives_text: The Dragonmaw Foreman at the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to kill 15 Nethermine Flayers and 5 Nethermine Ravagers.

records.name: To Rule The Skies
records.objectives_text: Sky Commander Keller has asked you to acquire Dragon Teeth and return them to him at the Skyguard Outpost atop the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: A Fel Whip For Gahk
records.objectives_text: Gahk has asked you to acquire a Fel Whip. Bring it to him at Ogri'la atop the Blade's Edge Mountains.

records.name: The Relic's Emanation
records.objectives_text: Chu'a'lor has asked you to return to him at Ogri'la atop the Blade's Edge Mountains after you have gained Apexis Emanations from an Apexis Relic.

records.objectives_text: Take the Murkblood Escape Plans to the Mistress of the Mines.

records.objectives_text: Find a Murkblood Overseer and interrogate him. Return to the Mistress of the Mines with the Murkblood information and the Hand of the Overseer.

records.objectives_text: Illidari Lord Balthas at Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley has tasked you with using the Soul Cannon on Reth'hedron the Subduer in Nagrand. You must also return the Soul Cannon.

records.objectives_text: Assist Commander Arcus and the Aldor in defending the Altar of Sha'tar. Once all of the Dragonmaw forces have been defeated, return to Overlord Mor'ghor at Dragonmaw Base Camp with the Aldor Medals.

records.objectives_text: Use the Skyguard bombs to destroy 15 Fel Cannonball Stacks.

objectives.text: Return to Barthamus at Shattrath in Terrokar Forest.

records.objectives_text: Visit the beer gardens outside of Silvermoon, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, zap three elekks at each location, and return to Glodrak Huntsniper. You must be drunk to see the pink elekks.

records.name: Stop the Fires!
records.objectives_text: The Costumed Orphan Matron wants you to help put out all the village fires (already burning). When they are out, speak again to the Costumed Orphan Matron.

records.name: The Headless Horseman
records.objectives_text: Find the Headless Horseman's Pumpkin Shrine.

records.name: Unleash the Raptors
records.objectives_text: Sergeant Lukas at North Point Tower wants you to place the Raptor Bait near the windmill in Blackhoof Village.

records.objectives_text: Take Petrov's Cluster Bombs and drop them on enough pirates to kill or destroy 25 Blockade Pirates and 10 Blockade Cannons. Once you've accomplished that, return to Bombardier Petrov at Westguard Keep.

wiki.page: Scare the Guano Out of Them!

records.objectives_text: Kill Goreclaw the Ravenous and report to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.

records.objectives_text: Defeat the new Amani warlord, Daakara.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.

records.objectives_text: Use Steelring's Foolproof Dynamite to collect 6 Whisper Gulch Ore Fragments and 18 Whisper Gulch Gems. Then return them to Sapper Steelring at Westguard Keep.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port.

records.objectives_text: Captain Harker aboard the Windrunner wants you to kill 15 North Fleet Marines.

records.objectives_text: Retrieve 10 boxes of Crafty's Stuff and return them to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.

records.objectives_text: Librarian Normantis on Amber Ledge wants you to use the Neural Needler on the Imprisoned Beryl Sorcerer until he reveals the location of Lady Evanor.

records.name: Hah... You're Not So Big Now!
records.objectives_text: Test out Crafty's Ultra-Advanced Proto-Typical Shortening Blaster on 5 Magmoth Crushers or Mates of Magmothregar. After you have done so, return to her at Fizzcrank Airstrip.

records.objectives_text: Search the Spire of Blood for more information about the Vial of Fresh Blood.

records.objectives_text: Destroy 5 Blood Globes and report to Snow Tracker Junek at Taunka'le Village.

records.name: Orabus the Helmsman

records.objectives_text: Seek out Karuk at Riplash Strand.

records.objectives_text: Help Getry defeat Varidus the Flenser at Warsong Farms. Report to Garrosh Hellscream should you succeed.

records.objectives_text: Speak to General Arlos inside the Inner Hold at Valiance Keep.
